independent.summary: The new index test only exercises the lifted type-word guard on the FULLTEXT line: the SPATIAL case uses index name `geom`, which is not in TYPE_WORDS (GEOMETRY is), so `SPATIAL KEY geom (geom)` was already read as an index before the fix. Re-introducing the guard for SPATIAL alone (e.g. `SPATIAL KEY point (p)`) would break parsing with no failing test; a type-word index name (`point`, `text`) was needed on that line to cover it.
